service.description: Resolve the unit price to charge for a product in a sales mode. isFixed=true => the mode uses explicit per-product prices; blocked=true => no price set.

Set (or clear) the explicit price of a product for a sales mode. For a Retail/MRP mode the per-product price IS the product MRP. For a fixed mode a positive price upserts PosProductModePrice; a null/zero price clears it (the product then cannot be sold in that mode).

service.description: Quantity-break auto-pricing. When a cart line is sold at RETAIL and its quantity reaches the product's per-product wholesale threshold (PosProductModePrice.thresholdQty on the WHOLESALE/WSL row), auto-switch that single line to the WHOLESALE price; once the quantity drops back below the threshold, revert it to RETAIL. The actual reprice + tax recompute is delegated to set#PosTransactionItemMode so tax-inclusive handling and the tax toggle are honored. Pure no-op when the product has no wholesale threshold configured, when the cashier has taken manual control of the line (manualPrice='Y'), or when the line is in some other mode (e.g. EMPLOYEE). Safe for tenants that configure no thresholds (e.g. MARUTHI) — it returns without touching anything.

parameter.name: cartModeId
parameter.description: The cart's current sales mode. Quantity-break only runs while the cart is in RETAIL (or default/blank); if the cashier deliberately put the cart in WHOLESALE/EMPLOYEE, lines are left under that explicit mode.
